mapper.select: SELECT id, producer_id, name, body, price, stock, category_id, origin_area, image, recommendation_score, create_at, update_at FROM products ORDER BY id

SELECT DISTINCT p.* FROM products p JOIN product_seasons ps ON p.id = ps.product_id JOIN seasons s ON ps.season_id = s.id WHERE ( s.start_month <= s.end_month AND #{month} BETWEEN s.start_month AND s.end_month ) OR ( s.start_month> s.end_month AND ( #{month} >= s.start_month OR #{month} <= s.end_month ) ) ORDER BY p.recommendation_score DESC LIMIT 4

SELECT DISTINCT p.* FROM products p
WHERE p.id IN (
SELECT oi2.product_id
FROM order_items oi1
INNER JOIN order_items oi2 ON oi1.order_id = oi2.order_id
WHERE oi1.product_id IN (
SELECT oi.product_id
FROM orders o
INNER JOIN order_items oi ON o.id = oi.order_id
WHERE o.user_id = #{userId}
)
AND oi2.product_id NOT IN (
SELECT oi.product_id
FROM orders o
INNER JOIN order_items oi ON o.id = oi.order_id
WHERE o.user_id = #{userId}
)
GROUP BY oi2.product_id
ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
)
SELECT * FROM products ORDER BY recommendation_score DESC
SELECT * FROM products WHERE price <= #{maxPrice} ORDER BY recommendation_score DESC LIMIT 10
